SCOPE: You may read the frontend sources and existing tests but edit ONLY the two named test files. Existing implementation is expected to be correct, so use TEST-ONLY mutation proof: add the tests; temporarily mutate the narrow relevant production seam in your local worktree or use a controlled test-local mutant that makes the new assertion fail for the named regression, capture RED output; undo the mutation fully; run GREEN. VERIFY: Run from `ui` using repository config: `bunx vitest run src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts src/App.test.tsx --config vitest.config.ts`. Report exact mutation RED assertion output and final GREEN counts. Also run `git diff --check -- ui/src/lib/sessionPersistence.test.ts ui/src/App.test.tsx`.
STOP WHEN: Both test-only cases exist, each demonstrably fails under its targeted temporary mutation and passes with production source restored; the exact test command is green and no production file remains changed by you.
